description: This file defines classes and methods for reading Excel files into pandas DataFrames, including extracting metadata about sheets and columns, as part of a database upload process in the Superset project.

classes.name: ExcelReaderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for reading Excel files, extending ReaderOptions with additional parameters like sheet name, column dates, and null values.

classes.name: ExcelReader
classes.description: A class for reading Excel files into pandas DataFrames and extracting sheet metadata, inheriting from BaseDataReader.

methods.name: file_to_dataframe
methods.description: Reads an uploaded Excel file into a pandas DataFrame, with error handling for parsing issues.

methods.name: file_metadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata from an Excel file, including sheet names and column headers.
